introHtml: Port Authority apparel is a top choice for corporate teams and organizations that need reliable, professional-quality clothing that fits well and lasts. From the C-FREE® recycled performance polo to the Grid Fleece Jacket, each piece is designed for comfort and durability. Whether you are outfitting a safety crew with enhanced visibility caps or branding uniforms for a company event, Port Authority offers consistent sizing and a wide range of styles for men, women, and youth. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, lasting logo.
